title: Polynomial approximation of a single-output AC⁰[p] circuit
statement:
Let $p$ be prime and let $n, \ell \in \bbn$. Let $F$ be a feedforward circuit over the alphabet $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with input type $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, a single output node, and a finite node set at every layer, each of whose gates is an $\mathrm{AC}^0[p]$ gate (the identity, NOT, an unbounded fan-in AND, or an unbounded $\mathrm{MOD}_p$ gate of some arity); write $d$ for its depth. For a Boolean input $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Fin}\,2$, let $\hat{x}$ be its coordinatewise image in $\bbz/p$ and let $F(x) \in \{0,1\} \subseteq \bbz/p$ be the resulting single output value cast into the field. Then there exist a nonempty finite seed set $\mathrm{Seed}$ and a family of polynomials $P_s \in (\bbz/p)[X_0,\dots,X_{n-1}]$ indexed by $s \in \mathrm{Seed}$, each of total degree at most $\bigl((p-1)\ell\bigr)^{d}$, such that for every Boolean input $x$,
\[
\abs{\{\,s \in \mathrm{Seed} : P_s(\hat{x}) \ne F(x)\,\}} \cdot 2^{\ell}
\;\le\;
G \cdot \abs{\mathrm{Seed}},
\]
where $G$ is the total number of non-input gates of $F$, that is, the total number of nodes across layers $1,\dots,d$.
hypotheses_covered: F is a feedforward circuit over Fin 2 with input type Fin n
F has a single (unique) output node
every layer of F has a finite node set
replaced:
The same statement for a circuit with a unique output node: there is a nonempty finite seed type and
polynomials $P(s)$ of total degree at most $\mathrm{circuitDegreeBound}(p,\ell,F.\mathrm{depth})$ such
that for every Boolean input $x$,
\[
\abs{\{s : P(s)(\mathrm{boolInput}_p\,x) \ne F.\mathrm{eval}_1\,x\}} \cdot 2^{\ell}
\;\le\; \mathrm{gateCountBefore}\,F\,F.\mathrm{depth} \cdot \abs{\mathrm{Seed}}.
\]
